news.title: Update 18.07.2025
news.content: Authorization via Steam has been added. Now all personal settings, such as interface language and other parameters, are saved in the account and automatically applied when logging in from any device/nMore features will be added in the future that will be available after logging into the account/nBugs have been fixed and overall site stability has been improved

news.title: Update 28.05.2026
news.content: Game update from 28.05.2026 has been successfully deployed to the website/nEach hero has been given an innate ability/nPage optimization and loading speed have been improved — pages should now run noticeably faster and more stable/nFixed a bug where upgrade numbers were not displayed when viewing a build via a link/nFixed an issue where some heroes' abilities were not displayed

news.title: Update 31.05.2026
news.content: The tournament page is back! With a new feature allowing you to select and view information about any tournament, not just the latest one/nFixed a bug where talent images did not appear when saving a build as an image/nImproved site optimization/nFixed some issues on Mac and iPhone
